purpose: Teach: カーボン/絶頂/アカデミック/水域/右折/前兆/全裸/盲目

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、カーボン製の凶器を、警察、鑑識されますね
lines.en: In this case, the police would have the carbon weapon examined by forensics, wouldn't they?
lines.style: Measured, slightly uncertain. Thinking aloud, as if testing the logic. Gentle rise at the end—inviting confirmation, not challenging.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、絶頂期の芸能人を狙う詐欺も担当されますね
lines.en: The police also handle fraud cases targeting celebrities at the height of their fame, don't they?
lines.style: Conversational, cooperative in tone. A gentle agreement-statement rather than correction. Leaning into the shared understanding of what police work entails.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、アカデミックな専門家のご鑑定を、警察、依頼されますね
lines.en: In this case, would the police request an academic specialist to conduct the forensic examination?
lines.style: Careful, slightly more formal. Respecting the expertise implied. A genuine question beneath the surface—seeking to understand the process.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、領海水域での密漁を取り締まりますね
lines.en: The police also crack down on illegal fishing in territorial waters, don't they?
lines.style: Matter-of-fact, procedural in tone. Stating it as simple fact. No interrogation—just acknowledgment of responsibility.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、交差点での右折事故、警察、対応されますね
lines.en: In this case, the police would respond to a right-turn accident at an intersection, wouldn't they?
lines.style: Steady, reflective. Pausing slightly before 'right-turn' as if considering the scenario. Quiet confidence in asking.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、犯行の前兆を見逃さず捜査されますね
lines.en: The police investigate without overlooking the early signs of criminal activity, don't they?
lines.style: Thoughtful, with quiet conviction. Respectful nod to professional diligence. Warm—almost admiring.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 本件、全裸での走行など迷惑行為を、警察、扱われますね
lines.en: In this case, the police would handle public disturbance matters like indecent exposure, wouldn't they?
lines.style: Steady and direct. No embarrassment or awkwardness—just stating a fact of police work. Clinical without coldness.

lines.speaker: takeda_officer
lines.jp: 警察、盲目の被害者のサポートにも当たられますね
lines.en: The police also support blind victims, don't they?
lines.style: Warm, sincere. Softer attack than previous lines. A moment of genuine recognition of the human side of the work. Close—almost intimate.
